class_imbalance._comment: tau is SEARCHED in [0.05, 0.8]. tau=1.0, the parameter-free default, over-corrects at this imbalance: dev fold 2 single-task `feature` scored 0.009 at tau=1.0 against 0.484 at tau=0.25.
class_imbalance._selected_by: grouped Optuna search over the dev folds

_provenance.selection: single Optuna search over all of train, dev folds as inner CV
_provenance.why: per-outer-fold hyperparameters would be selected on fold difficulty; fold 4 scored 0.453 against 0.154-0.238 because it had 98.8 % in-vocabulary coverage and a 75.3 % majority class

_comment: Calibration refit: same final hyperparameters, fitted on 4 of the 5 BioProject-grouped dev folds. The held-back fold is BioProject-disjoint from this fit, so its probabilities are out-of-fold and temperature fitted on them is not fitted on data the model saw.
